channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Trump photo shows him viewing "Kennedy Center demolished" document
item.description: In court documents filed Wednesday by Rep. Joyce Beatty, a witness said he saw a "forklift run into and hit the pillars" of the building.

item.title: U.N. experts: U.S. may have committed war crimes in 2 Iran strikes
item.description: U.N.-commissioned rights experts say there are "reasonable grounds" to believe the U.S. committed war crimes with strikes that killed scores of Iranians.

item.title: Police: Images from Philadelphia home show 5 women who appear deceased
item.description: Authorities say images and videos recovered from a Philadelphia home show five women who appear to be deceased.

item.title: English village votes to leave U.K. in protest over asylum seeker housing
item.description: Residents of Piddington, a village of 350 people, voted 285 to 26 in a symbolic referendum to leave the United Kingdom over nearby asylum seeker housing.
